# Transcription

**Document type:** Portal record export (screenshot/PDF of a web page). Browser-style title bar reads "secure record view".

**Header text:**
- Left: "SERVICE PORTAL · RECORD EXPORT" (displayed as spaced letters in the source)
- Right: "Gas safety portal record"

**Banner:** Flintmere Gas Services — Customer Portal

**Summary box:**
- Gas Safety Record
- Property: 8 Brindlewick Row, Vellum Quay, ZZ1 1ZZ
- Job reference: NBL-48217

**Table (Field / Entry):**

| Field | Entry |
|---|---|
| Visit date | 09 October 2025 |
| Visit time | 09:05–10:02 |
| Engineer | Tavin Rell |
| Job status | Complete |
| Recorded outcome | Satisfactory |
| Appliances on job card | Boiler; cooker |
| Record created | 09 October 2025, 10:08 |
| Customer document | Processing |

**Footer note box:** *Portal view captured 10 October 2025, 09:56*

No amounts, signatures, certificate numbers, or other text appear on the page. The lower part of the page is blank apart from a horizontal rule at the bottom.

# Unclear, missing or inconsistent

- **Customer document is "Processing":** The actual gas safety certificate is not yet available as of the capture time (10 Oct 2025, 09:56), about 23 hours after the record was created. The record itself is only a portal summary.
- **No appliance-level detail:** Only the appliance names on the job card ("Boiler; cooker") are listed. There are no make/model, location, test readings, or per-appliance pass/fail results. It is not stated whether both appliances were actually inspected or tested.
- **"Satisfactory" outcome is unsupported by detail:** There are no defects, warnings, or notes fields shown, so it cannot be confirmed from this view whether any were recorded.
- **Missing identifiers:** No Gas Safe registration number for the engineer or company, no certificate or record number (only job reference NBL-48217), no customer or landlord name, and no next-inspection due date.
- **Document type not specified:** It does not say whether this is a landlord gas safety record (CP12), a service record, or another type, and gives no expiry or validity date.
- **Timing:** The record was created at 10:08, six minutes after the visit ended at 10:02. This is plausible and not an inconsistency, but the visit time is shown without a time zone.
- **Address:** The postcode "ZZ1 1ZZ" appears to be a placeholder-style postcode. It is transcribed as written and has not been verified.

Dear Riva,

Re: 8 Brindlewick Row, Vellum Quay, ZZ1 1ZZ – your job NBL-48217, our ref R/002.

The last signed gas safety record we hold for this property is dated 16 October 2024, so we urgently need the signed record from the 9 October visit. Could you please confirm:
1. What appliance installation detail your quality desk is checking, and whether it affects the safe use of the boiler or cooker.
2. The date you expect to issue the signed record, with the engineer's Gas Safe details.
3. A price for a separate boiler lockout diagnostic. The tenant reports repeated lockouts that clear on reset. Please do not book or carry out this work: the landlord has not approved it and will decide once she has the price.

Kind regards,
Donna
Northbridge Lettings

Re: 8 Brindlewick Row, Vellum Quay, ZZ1 1ZZ – ref R/002 (Flintmere job NBL-48217).

1. The signed gas safety record from the 9 October visit.
